what.title: What is autism? Prevalence, ADDM 1 in 31 and why numbers rose
what.description: How common autism is worldwide (1 in 127) and in the US (1 in 31), why diagnoses rose, the 3:1 sex ratio and age at diagnosis, animated and cited.

words.title: Autistic person or person with autism? Double empathy and masking
words.description: Identity-first vs person-first language, the double empathy problem, masking and autistic burnout, and the neurodiversity model, with cited evidence.

senses.title: Autism and the senses: overload, meltdown, shutdown and supports
senses.description: Animated sensory day: hyper- and hypo-reactivity, overload, meltdown versus shutdown, stimming, hyperacusis rates and which supports have trial evidence.

genes.title: Autism genetics: heritability, twins, risk genes, testing
genes.description: How genes shape autism: twin studies and 80% heritability, common and de novo variants, 16p11.2, fragile X, sibling recurrence and genetic test yields.

risk.title: Autism risk factors and myths: what does not cause autism
risk.description: Prenatal risk factors on a forest plot with absolute risks, why vaccines and parenting do not cause autism, and paracetamol in pregnancy explained.

brain.title: The autistic brain in development: synapses and pruning
brain.description: Brain growth from pregnancy to age 4, synapse pruning, infant MRI findings, E/I balance and other hypotheses with evidence labels. No scan diagnoses autism.

milestones.title: Early signs of autism: milestones and red flags, 0–36 months
milestones.description: Animated CDC 2022 milestones from birth to 3 years, early signs of autism, joint attention, loss of skills and what to do if you are worried. Cited.

screening.title: Autism screening: M-CHAT-R/F, Q-CHAT, AQ-10 and predictive value
screening.description: Follow 1,000 toddlers through M-CHAT-R/F screening and try a PPV calculator: why a positive screen is not a diagnosis. Teaching tools only. Cited.

criteria.title: DSM-5-TR and ICD-11 autism criteria and support levels
criteria.description: Interactive walk-through of DSM-5-TR autism criteria A–E, support levels 1–3, specifiers and ICD-11 6A02.0–.5, plus how the names changed since 1980.

assessment.title: Autism diagnostic assessment: ADOS-2, ADI-R and waits
assessment.description: How autism is assessed in children and adults: the team, ADOS-2 and ADI-R accuracy, waiting times, median age at diagnosis and look-alike conditions.

cooccur.title: Autism co-occurring conditions: ADHD, anxiety, epilepsy
cooccur.description: How often autistic people also have ADHD, anxiety, depression, OCD, epilepsy or intellectual disability, when each tends to appear, and the AuDHD overlap.

supports.title: Autism early intervention evidence: Project AIM, PACT and goals
supports.description: How strong is the evidence for early autism supports? Watch Project AIM effects shrink under stricter filters and follow the PACT trial for six years.

aba.title: ABA therapy for autism: history, evidence and critique
aba.description: Sixty years of behavioural approaches, from Lovaas and EIBI to NDBIs, with proponents' and autistic critics' arguments and a functional assessment ABC analyser.

therapies.title: Autism communication and therapies: AAC, PECS, OT, PEERS and CBT
therapies.description: AAC does not stop speech: PECS phases, speech-generating devices and a comparator of speech, OT, social skills, adapted CBT and music therapy, with evidence.

meds.title: Autism medication: risperidone, aripiprazole, melatonin
meds.description: No medicine treats autism itself. What risperidone and aripiprazole do for severe irritability, their side effects, and ADHD and sleep medicines.

unproven.title: Unproven autism treatments: secretin, chelation, diets
unproven.description: How secretin, chelation, hyperbaric oxygen, special diets and stem-cell clinics rose and fell, why vaccines do not cause autism, and how to judge claims.

frontier.title: Autism research: oxytocin, bumetanide, leucovorin
frontier.description: Autism trials 2010–2026 with evidence labels: failed drugs, early leads such as leucovorin, FDA-cleared diagnostic aids and what autistic people want studied.

school.title: Autism at school and home: supports, IEP, EHCP and family life
school.description: An animated school day with visual schedules, TEACCH and quiet spaces, an IEP/504/EHCP navigator, and cited facts on bullying, absence and caregiver stress.

adult.title: Autistic adults: late diagnosis, work, burnout and ageing
adult.description: Follow an autistic life from 16 to 75: the services cliff, work and study, masking and burnout, late diagnosis and ageing, with a workplace adjustments tool.

health.title: Autism physical health: epilepsy, sleep, gut and safety
health.description: Epilepsy, sleep and melatonin, gut and feeding problems, teeth, weight, wandering and drowning in autism, and mortality and suicide data handled with care.

nursing.title: Autism nursing care: adapted hospital visits and pain assessment
nursing.description: An animated blood-test visit comparing usual and autism-adapted nursing care, a FLACC pain walkthrough, hospital passports, meltdowns and restraint data.

history.title: History of autism: Bleuler, Sukhareva, Kanner, Asperger to DSM-5
history.description: An animated timeline of autism from Bleuler (1911) and Sukhareva to Kanner, Asperger, Wing, DSM-5, ICD-11 and neurodiversity, with every date cited.

review.title: Autism flashcards and mnemonics: DSM-5-TR, M-CHAT-R/F, red flags
review.description: 89 cited autism flashcards and 10 memory aids, from prevalence and genetics to DSM-5-TR all-3-A, any-2-B, M-CHAT-R/F bands and red flags.

quiz.title: Autism quiz: 97 questions with cited explanations, by part
quiz.description: Test yourself on autism: prevalence, genes, vaccines, screening, DSM-5-TR and ICD-11, ABA, medicines, school, adulthood and history.

glossary.title: Autism glossary: 160+ terms from AAC to the services cliff
glossary.description: A searchable glossary of autism terms, from alexithymia, ADOS and M-CHAT-R/F to NDBI, ICD-11 6A02 and autistic burnout, each linked to its module.

sources.title: Autism Companion sources: every validated reference
sources.description: Every reference behind the Autism Companion: studies, guidelines, FDA labels and trials, each checked against PubMed, Europe PMC or Crossref.
